runs.text: You have to find a name in an alphabetically sorted list of 1000 names. Which way of searching suits, and how many steps does it need at most?
With 1000 values, brute force may need 1000 steps; searching by halves, 10. With a million, the difference is between a million and 20.
One by one, from the start: at most 500 steps.

justification.text: In the worst case the name is at the end, or it is not there: 1000 steps.
Each step discards half: 1000, 500, 250, … in 10 steps only one is left.
Discarding half ten times already leaves a single name.

runs.text: It makes no difference: both take the same in the worst case.

justification.text: One by one may need 1000 steps; by halves, 10.
